A special mention to Samridhi and Abhishek—every little detail was handled so meticulously. From smooth logistics to constant support throughout the trip, it was clear how much effort went into making this journey seamless and memorable.

The stays were absolutely stunning—each hotel felt handpicked, whether it was for breathtaking views or perfect central locations. Waking up to those Icelandic landscapes is something I’ll never forget.

What I loved most was how effortless everything felt. No stress, no confusion—just pure travel joy.

Already finding myself thinking about the next trip… New Zealand maybe? Fingers crossed it happens soon 🤞

Thank you, PassportBlu, for such a beautifully curated experience. This was more than just a trip—it was a memory for a lifetime.
